about: FIA Women's Fashion is a Bangladesh-based women's clothing catalogue featuring linen palazzos, Swiss cotton palazzos and Swiss cotton skirts. Explore photographs by colour.
delivery: FIA offers delivery across Bangladesh, subject to coverage confirmation. Delivery charges and expected delivery times depend on the address and will be confirmed through WhatsApp before the order is finalized. Cash on Delivery is available
returns: FIA advertises free replacement for 7 days no questions asked. Please contact the FIA Facebook page or WhatsApp with your order details for initiating a return. Make sure the product is unused and the tag remains intact.
sizeIntro: Free size is not one universal measurement. Ask FIA for the confirmed waistband range, garment length and hem opening of your exact design and colour before placing an order.
privacy: This website is a public product catalogue and does not ask customers to create an account or submit an address or phone number on the site. It uses normal browser caching for performance. Cloudflare or Netlify, as the host, may process technical request information. When you contact FIA through WhatsApp, Meta's privacy practices also apply. Customer order information should not be included in the public website catalogue. Contact FIA through WhatsApp about any information you shared during an order.
customerCare: Questions about products, delivery, replacements or order details? Send a message to FIA on WhatsApp at +8801727470967.
